newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.785 billion yuan from 2.384 billion yuan with the seven-day contract the most actively traded.
Trading was less active mainly because head offices of state-run banks traded less, traders said.
In addition, the seven foreign banks recently granted the right to trade on the market were not active, they said.

Short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, were active traders on Thursday with non-banking financial institutions including securities houses borrowing heavily from the centres, traders said.
Traders said they believed the rates would move little in dull trading on Friday.
